findings.message: None of the four new Resources lifecycle events has a consumer anywhere in the solution. Each is published only by its owning module (Resources), which is correct, and each payload carries identifiers only. But no IEventHandler<T> exists for any of them, and there is no Availability module in backend/src/Modules yet. The story lists 'Availability module read models and handlers consuming the new events' as out of scope. Owner decision needed: confirm that these four contracts are meant to ship without a consumer until the Availability module exists, and record which story/module will own the handlers. Until then the events are published into the broker with no subscriber. I have not resolved this.
findings.evidence: Events/Resources/ResourceSchemaCreatedEvent.cs:3 `public record ResourceSchemaCreatedEvent(Guid SchemaId, Guid GroupId) : IEvent;` | ResourceSchemaDeletedEvent.cs:3 `(Guid SchemaId, Guid GroupId)` | ResourceInstanceCreatedEvent.cs:3 `(Guid ResourceId, Guid SchemaId)` | ResourceInstanceDeletedEvent.cs:3 `(Guid ResourceId, Guid SchemaId)`. Publishers (only): CreateResourceTypeCommandHandler.cs:58, CreateResourceInstanceCommandHandler.cs:86, DeleteResourceTypeCommandHandler.cs:51, DeleteResourceInstanceCommandHandler.cs:42, all in ThingsBooksy.Modules.Resources.Core. Handlers: a solution-wide search for `IEventHandler<` finds only Resources.Core/Events/Handlers (GroupCreated, GroupDeleted, GroupMemberAdded, GroupMemberRemoved) and ManagementGroups.Core UserSignedUpHandler. None of them handles Resource*Event. The only other references are in Resources.IntegrationTests/Events/*.
findings.suggested_fix: Owner decision: either (a) accept the four events as contracts awaiting the future Availability module and record that in the story/decision log, or (b) schedule the Availability consumer story before these events are relied on.

rule_candidate.description: Every IEvent type in ThingsBooksy.Shared.Abstractions.Events.* must have at least one IEventHandler<T> implementation in some module .Core assembly, or be listed in an explicit allow-list of events awaiting a future consumer (with the owning story id).

findings.chosen: Accept: contracts awaiting the Availability module
